# Document

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

High-level entry point for creating PDF documents. Provides a simplified API for adding elements, setting metadata, and saving PDFs.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IDisposable`.

```csharp
new Document()
new Document(DocumentSettings settings)
new Document(DocumentMetadata metadata)
new Document(DocumentSettings settings, DocumentMetadata metadata)
```

- [`Fonts`](#fonts): The fonts that belong to this document: any number of families and faces.

### `Attachments`

```csharp
IList<FileAttachment> Attachments { get; }
```

*read-only*

Files embedded into the generated PDF as associated files (PDF/A-3 / ZUGFeRD). Add to this collection directly, or use the `Attach` / `Attach` helpers. Embedded files are honoured under `None`, PDF/A-3 and PDF/A-4f; under PDF/A-1, PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-4 they are dropped at save time with a diagnostic, keeping the conformance claim honest. Under PDF/UA-2, an attachment with no `Description` is described by its file name and records a warning.

> A list you can add to and remove from. The property itself cannot be replaced. To add one, call `Attach()`.

Example:

```csharp
doc.Attachments.Add(new FileAttachment("data.csv", bytes, AttachmentRelationship.Data, "text/csv")); Console.WriteLine(doc.Attachments.Count); // 1
```

### `Diagnostics`

```csharp
IReadOnlyList<Diagnostic> Diagnostics { get; }
```

*read-only*

Recoverable issues collected during the most recent Save / SaveAsync / GenerateBytes call - typically font load failures or subset fallbacks. Empty before generation. Call `PrintDiagnostics` to surface them via the console, or inspect directly to feed into custom UI / telemetry.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`.

### `Fonts`

```csharp
DocumentFonts Fonts { get; }
```

*read-only*

The fonts that belong to this document: any number of families and faces. Nothing added here is visible to another document, and the global font registries are unchanged. A family named here is resolved before the global and standard ones.

Example:

```csharp
doc.Fonts.Add(regularBytes, family: "Inter"); doc.Fonts.Add(boldBytes, family: "Inter", weight: FontWeight.Bold); doc.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "Hello", FontFamily = "Inter", FontWeight = FontWeight.Bold });
```

### `Add`

```csharp
void Add(params string[] lines)
void Add(IEnumerable<string> lines)
void Add(IElement element)
```

Adds one paragraph from lines joined by hard line breaks.

Example:

```csharp
var doc = new Document(); doc.Add(new TextBlock("Quarterly report") { FontSize = 20 }); doc.Add(new TextBlock("Prepared by Operations"));
```

### `AddPage`

```csharp
Page AddPage()
Page AddPage(PdfSize pageSize)
Page AddPage(PdfSize pageSize, float margin)
Page AddPage(PdfSize pageSize, PageOrientation orientation)
Page AddPage(PdfSize pageSize, PageOrientation orientation, float margin)
```

Adds a new page to the document

Example:

```csharp
var doc = new Document(); doc.Add(new TextBlock("First page")); doc.AddPage(); // start a new page doc.Add(new TextBlock("Second page"));
```

### `Attach`

```csharp
Document Attach(FileAttachment attachment)
Document Attach(string fileName, byte[] content, AttachmentRelationship relationship = AttachmentRelationship.Unspecified, string mediaType = null)
```

Embeds a file into the document. Returns this document for chaining.

Example:

```csharp
doc.Attach(new FileAttachment { FileName = "invoice.xml", Content = xmlBytes, Relationship = AttachmentRelationship.Alternative, MediaType = "text/xml", });
```

Example:

```csharp
doc.Attach("data.csv", bytes, AttachmentRelationship.Data, "text/csv");
```

### `FromDefinitionAsync`

```csharp
Task<Document> FromDefinitionAsync(string json, DefinitionReadOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Task<Document> FromDefinitionAsync(JsonElement definition, DefinitionReadOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

*static*

Builds a document from a Document Definition given as JSON text. The definition is validated completely first; if it has any problem this throws a `DefinitionException` that lists them all, and nothing is constructed.


### `GenerateSvgDocument`

```csharp
SvgDocumentExport GenerateSvgDocument(SvgPageExportOptions options = null)
```

Like `GenerateSvgPages`, but also returns `@font-face` CSS embedding a minimal subset of the fonts the document uses. Inject the CSS once into the host page so the SVG renders with the exact fonts used for layout, independent of what the viewer has installed.

### `GenerateSvgPages`

```csharp
IReadOnlyList<string> GenerateSvgPages(SvgPageExportOptions options = null)
```

Renders every laid-out page of the document to a standalone SVG string.

Runs the same layout, pagination, watermark, and header/footer pipeline as PDF output, so the returned list has one entry per generated PDF page and the visual layout matches.

- `options`: Export options; defaults are used when `null`.

Example, from `BonniePDF.Examples.PracticalRecipes/Program`:

```csharp
var pages = document.GenerateSvgPages();
```

### `GenerateSvgPagesAsync`

```csharp
Task<IReadOnlyList<string>> GenerateSvgPagesAsync(SvgPageExportOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Asynchronous sibling of `GenerateSvgPages`. SVG export is CPU-bound and runs synchronously, after calling any registered `SvgRasterizer` the document's SVG elements need.

Example:

```csharp
IReadOnlyList<string> pages = await doc.GenerateSvgPagesAsync(new SvgPageExportOptions { MaxPages = 1 });
```

### `SaveAsync`

```csharp
Task SaveAsync(string path, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Task SaveAsync(Stream stream, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

```

Asynchronously saves the document to the specified file path

- `path`: The path to save the PDF to

- `stream`: The stream to write the PDF to

### `ToDefinition`

```csharp
DefinitionWriteResult ToDefinition(DefinitionWriteOptions options = null)
```

Writes this document as a Document Definition: JSON data, with a note for anything the writer had to say. Reading it back with `FromDefinitionAsync` gives a document that renders identically.

- `options`: What to do with what cannot be written, and how to write resources.
